annotations.text:
Tab5 launcher + FM synth, 1280x720, same instrument language as the radio.
SOUND: four macro dials shape any patch; EXPERT opens the full operator editor.
PLAY: chord pads + keys + arp + scale lock for one-finger playing.
SEQ: 4 tracks, 16 steps, song chain, render to Sonos / card / Mac.
Knobs = the two live parameters on each screen. Patch names are invented sample data.
